Automatically navigates DigiWorld, detects the grid dynamically and collects energy. Screen sharing and accessibility control must be active.\n\nIMPORTANT: Select Botamon as the visible sprite. Other sprites may prevent reliable player detection.

Samsung: trigger the blocked-access warning once, then open Settings → Apps → DigiWorldExplorer Bot → three-dot menu → Allow restricted settings.

Important: Botamon must be selected as the visible sprite in DIGIMON UP.

If something does not work, first use “Stop everything”, then fully close DIGIMON UP and DigiWorldExplorer. Start DIGIMON UP first and wait until the game is fully loaded. Only then open DigiWorldExplorer, start screen sharing and enable automation.

OFF by default. Automatically starts Network Defense Ops, waits through all five waves and then detects the red-and-black Diaboromon banner. The bot repeatedly taps “Give up”, returns to the selection and starts the next attempt. This can count roughly 40 defeated enemies per run. Enable only inside Network Defense Ops.

Automatically uses the yellow 30-ticket summon button on supported green and purple reward screens. It keeps tapping briefly through the loading transition and stops when the ticket cost turns red. Disable this option whenever you want to summon manually.

Automatically starts a detected VS dungeon challenge, waits without tapping during the battle, closes the reward screen and starts the next level. Detection uses the screen layout and works independently of the game language. The mode stops after 15 seconds without visible progress.
